name: Ferienwohnung Kitzbichler
beschreibung:
Peacefully located in Erl, Ferienwohnung Kitzbichler welcomes visitors with dedicated care and comfortable living space including a scenic mountain-view balcony.

The Tyrol Festival, trails to the Blaubergalm, and riverside cycling along the Inn are all close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kitzbichler in Erl provides sunny relaxation in the festival village of Kufsteinerland.
